xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
The above Financial Results (FR) have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the BoD at their respective meetings held on May 06,2026.
The above FR have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards ("Ind AS"), prescribed under Sec. 133 of the Co’s Act, 2013 read with relevant rules thereunder and in terms of Reg. 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
Rane (Madras) Ltd ('the Co.') and its subsidiaries (collectively referred to as 'the Group') are primarily engaged in the manufacture and supply of auto components for the transportation industry which in the context of (Ind AS) 108 Operating Segments, is considered as the only operating segment of the Grp.
There are no unallocated corporate income / expense / asset and liabilities considering that the Grp operates in a single segment.
Exceptional items in the above FR include the following:
- The Co. incurred voluntary retirement exp. amounting to INR 0.87 crs. in the Q.E Dec 31, 2025 and INR 3.47 crs. for Y.E Mar 31, 2026.
- The Co. has primarily incurred merger related expenses (including stamp duty charges), one-time warranty costs and expenditure towards VRS amounting to INR 11.81 crores for quarter ended Mar 31, 2025 and INR 12.99 crs. for Y.E Mar 31, 2025.
The BoD of the Co. in its meeting held on Feb 09, 2024, had approved the scheme of amalgamation (the Scheme), of the fellow subsidiaries of the Co. viz. Rane Brake Lining Ltd (RBL) and Rane Engine Valve Ltd (REVL) with the Co. w.e.f Apr 1, 2024 under Sec. 230 to 232 of the Co’s Act, 2013 and other applicable provisions. The aforesaid Scheme was sanctioned by Hon’ble NCLT vide order dated Mar 24, 2025. The Scheme has become effective from Apr 01, 2024 upon filing of the certified copy of the orders passed by NCLT with the relevant RoC on Apr 07, 2025.
The amalgamation has been accounted in accordance with “Pooling of interest method” as laid down in Appendix C - ‘Business combinations of entities under common control’ of Ind AS 103 notified under Sec. 133 of the Co’s Act read with the Co.’s (IAS) Rules, 2015. The diff between the assets, liabilities, acquired reserves and shares transferred were transferred to Capital Reserves amounting to INR 3.59 crs. during the Y.E Mar 31, 2025.
Pursuant to the allotment of equity shares on Apr 23, 2025 in accordance with the share exchange ratio prescribed in the Scheme of Amalgamation, the issued and paid up share capital of the Co. stands increased to INR 27,63,71,370 comprising of 2,76,37,137 Eq. Sh’s of INR 10/- each fully paid up.
The Co. has entered into an agreement with Canopy Living LLP (A JV between Arihant Foundations & Housing Ltd and Prestige Estates Project Ltd) to sell 3.48 acres of land in Velachery for an aggregate consideration of INR 361.18 crores. Pursuant to this agreement, the Co. has received an advance of INR 145 crs till Mar 31, 2026. The Co. currently owns a total land parcel of 4.50 acres in Velachery and it will retain the balance portion of 1.02 acres for constructing a new office.
Accordingly, the carrying value of the said land, amounting to INR 0.02 crores, has been classified under ' Assets Held-for-Sale' in accordance with Ind AS 105 "Non-current assets held for sale and discontinued operations".
The CG has notified the Code on Wages, 2019, the Code on Social Security, 2020, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, collectively referred to as the 'New Labour Codes', effective from Nov 21, 2025. Based on its assessment, the best information available and legal advice obtained, the Co. has recorded the incremental impact of Employee benefits expense amounting to INR 0.72 crs for the Q.E Mar 31, 2026, INR 2.45 crs for the Q.E Dec 31, 2025 and INR 3.17 crores for the Y.E Mar 31, 2026. The Co. continues to monitor the developments on finalisation of Central / State Rules and clarifications from the Govt on other aspects of the Labour Code and would provide appropriate accounting effects on the basis of such developments as needed.
During the Y.E Mar 31, 2025, erstwhile REVL had elected to opt for the new tax regime under the ITA, 1961 with effect from FY 2023-24 resulting in an addl tax exp. of INR 14.20 crs. (including INR 5.93 crs. on account of reversal of MAT credit) due to remeasurement of the DTA (net).
The BoD of the Co. in its meeting held on May 06, 2026, has recommended a dividend of Rs.16/- per eq. share of Rs. 10/- each (i.e., 160% of FV) for the FY ended Mar 31, 2026, subject to the approval of sh’s in the ensuing AGM.
The figures for the Q.E Mar 31, 2026 and Mar 31, 2025 as reported in these FR are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of the full FY and the published unaudited year to date figures up to the end of the third qtr of the relevant FY.
The Standalone and Consolidated FR for the Y.E Mar 31, 2026 are being published in the newspaper as per the format prescribed under Reg. 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The Standalone and Consolidated FR are also available on the SE websites of BSE (www.bseindia.com) and NSE (www.nseindia.com) and on the Co.'s website viz., www.ranegroup.com.
